name: rpgcharcontroller-mobile
description: Wrapper Capacitor + nodejs-mobile pra empacotar o RPGCharController como APK Android.

scripts.bundle: npm run bundle:frontend && npm run bundle:backend
scripts.cap:sync: npx cap sync android && node scripts/sync-nodejs-mobile.js
scripts.gradle:debug: node scripts/gradle-build.js debug && node scripts/verify-apk.js debug
scripts.gradle:release: node scripts/gradle-build.js release && node scripts/verify-apk.js release
scripts.build:debug: npm run bundle && npm run cap:sync && npm run gradle:debug
scripts.build:release: npm run bundle && npm run cap:sync && npm run gradle:release
